thread:
maria: Quick sync — planning to flip the new audit/PII mode for the canary tomorrow morning (audit_mode_v3). Putting checklist here.

maria: Goal: enable audit path that sends PII metadata to KMS-encrypted store but with retention grace window = 7d, scrub names/emails on transit.

alex: ✓ noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 contains the KMS path changes and feature flag wiring.

jin: Can we confirm which flag controls retention override vs audit_enabled? I thought there were two: `audit_mode_v3` and `pii_retention_override`.

maria: Correct. We'll enable audit_mode_v3 scoped to beta-customers and set pii_retention_override=false by default. Canary plan: 10% internal -> 25% beta -> full.

sre-lead: Add SLO guardrail: if 5xx rate or tail latency > 500ms increase for >5m, auto-rollback. Also ensure KV cache metrics are stable.

maria: Good call. Putting rollback rule in rollout policy and adding health checks to the deploy job.

security-oncall: Quick questions: (1) is HSM used for signing KMS keys or soft KMS? (2) audit logs retention on the audit-store — where is that set?

alex: HSM path enabled for enterprise tenants in PR; default hosted accounts use KMS with CMKs. Audit-store retention set via `retention_policy` in infra config (see PR). We'll add tenant-level override gated by `pii_retention_override` flag.

jin: Need to ensure scrubber runs before logs hit the audit-store. Recommend pattern: scrub -> tag as audited -> encrypt -> send.

maria: That's the flow. Sample toggler command for the canary:

``
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/audit_mode_v3/toggle \
  -d '{"enabled": true, "scope": ["internal-canary"], "percent": 10}'
``

maria: Also scheduling a short canary window 02:00-05:00 UTC to minimize impact. Will monitor `audit_store.encryption.errors`, `scrubber.failures`, `tokenization.rate` dashboards.

sre-lead: Ping me 30m before flip. I'll have rollback playbook ready and will watch infra alerts.

security-oncall: I can sign off once the HSM fallback test passes and we have an E2E log with scrubbed fields. Can someone post a redacted sample event?

alex: Added a redacted sample event to the PR description and to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/audit-mode-v3

maria: Awesome. Final ask: @security-oncall @sre-lead please respond with +1 if you approve the canary. I'll hold until both +1s.

security-oncall: +1 pending HSM fallback smoke.

sre-lead: +1, will be on watch.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: audit_mode_v3 -> internal-canary -> 10% at 2026-02-10T02:00:00Z; monitoring at https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts

maria: Thanks all — will post results here after the canary.
